281. (Currently amended) A tool comprising a lamination of at least two layers and __at least two__ adhesive layers, the tool comprising first and second layers and a first adhesive layer configured to be cured on the first layer and a second adhesive layer configured to be cured on the second layer, the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer configured to be cured to each other, the tool __having__ a circular shape and __further including__ a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments having an inner arc shape and an outer arc shape, wherein the inner arc shape of each of the arc-shaped cutting segments is directly affixed to an outer perimeter of the first and second layers, and a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and the first layer and the second layer are aligned with the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer, __wherein each of the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer is a sheet of adhesive having a substantially uniform thickness produced by placing the sheet of adhesive between the first layer and the medial section and between the second layer and the medial section, respectively.__

282. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 wherein the medial section comprises a metal.

283. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 282 wherein the metal is [[a honeycomb structure]] __steel__.

284. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 wherein the medial section is [[a composite material]] __fiber reinforced plastic__.

285. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments, __the weld ring being a separate member from the first and second layers and from the medial section__.

286. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section.

287. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the plurality of cutting segments are also welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring.

288. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the weld ring is continuous.

289. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the weld ring is segmented __into a plurality of circumferentially spaced apart ring segments__.

290. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 further including an inner ring, wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring.

291. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 290 wherein the inner ring includes [[central opening]] __a central opening__.

293. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments, such that the plurality of cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring, __the weld ring being a separate member from the first and second layers and from the medial section__.

294. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 293 wherein the weld ring is continuous.

295. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 293 wherein the weld ring is segmented __into a plurality of circumferentially spaced apart ring segments__.
